title: Ijwi ryanze kwiheba
intro: Jya mu rugo aho igihombo gikurikira igihombo, ariko ijwi rimwe rituje ntirigire icyo rigeraho. Guhamagara rimwe muri Korowani bihindura kwihangana mu mpinduka; ushobora gukurikirana ibimenyetso by'uwo muntu uri inyuma y'iryo jwi?
clues: Nari ijwi ry'ukwihangana mu rugo aho imigisha yageragejwe n'ibyago.
Nagumye mu rugo rwari rudafite abantu benshi kubera kubura ubutunzi n'abana.
Nari nzi ko indwara na yo yari yarigeze gufata uwo mugenzi we, umubiri we wari urwaye.
Ubwo umubabaro wari ukomeye, nahamagaye nibutsa Allah.
Natanze itangazo rimwe: Allah ni Ukuri, bityo komeza kwihangana.
Nahamagaye Ayyub mu izina; nyuma yaho, Imana yakuyeho imibabaro kandi isubiza umuryango mu mutekano.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Gugumana na Ayyub mu gihe cyo gupfusha no kurwara, hanyuma ugasaba kwihangana
Umuburo w'intumwa ikiranuka wo kureka umuryango wanduye
Gusengera ivuka ry'umuryango w'ejo hazaza
Gusobanura inzozi muri gereza y'ibwami
Gushaka umwana w'umubyeyi iruhande rw'umugezi
trial.answer: Gugumana na Ayyub mu gihe cyo gupfusha no kurwara, hanyuma ugasaba kwihangana

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Gutangaza ko Allah ari Ukuri n'ukwihangana birakenewe

Inzozi z'inyenyeri cumi n'imwe n'izuba riva
Igitebo cyari gitwaye ku ruzi rwa Nili
location.answer: Gutangaza ko Allah ari Ukuri n'ukwihangana birakenewe

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Imibabaro ya Ayyub yarakuweho maze umuryango we usubizwa mu buzima bwe
Umwana wari utegerejwe igihe kirekire yahawe nyuma yo gusenga nk'ingumba
Umutware ukiri muto yasobanuye imyaka irindwi y'uburumbuke n'ubukene
Umwana w'umubyeyi yarokowe mu mazi atemba
Umuburo wabanjirije umwuzure wangiza
outcome.answer: Imibabaro ya Ayyub yarakuweho maze umuryango we usubizwa mu buzima bwe
